query_text: What is the procedure for updating a minor spelling error in an Aadhaar name such as Ram to Rama?
ground_truth_passage: Annexure A, Category 1 (Minor Name Change), Scenario (d): Names are phonetically similar: Applicable POI required. No Gazette/Affidavit required.

query_text: How can an applicant expand abbreviations or initials into a full name in Aadhaar (e.g. V. S. Prasad to Vaddi Venkata Rama Siva Prasad)?
ground_truth_passage: Annexure A, Category 1, Scenario (a): Abbreviation to expanded name: Applicable POI in support of full name.

query_text: What are the documentation requirements for a Major Name Change in Aadhaar where identity completely changes from Ram Kumar to Shyam Gupta?
ground_truth_passage: Annexure A, Category 5, Scenario (o): Complete change of name / change of identity: POI (only Gazette Notification for name change).

query_text: What affidavit and proofs are mandated for changing a woman surname in Aadhaar post-marriage or divorce?
ground_truth_passage: Annexure A, Category 4, Scenario (b) & Annexure D: Prescribed Affidavit on Rs. 10 stamp paper + Marriage Certificate / Divorce Decree / POI.

query_text: What is the required workflow when a name was incorrectly recorded due to an enrolment operator data entry error?
ground_truth_passage: Annexure A, Category 2, Scenario (f): For adults: Affidavit (Annexure B) & POI/POR; For minors: Affidavit (Annexure C) & POI/POR.

query_text: Which form is required for an individual to request corrections in their PAN card data?
ground_truth_passage: Request For Changes Or Correction in PAN Data [For an Individual] (Form CSF).

query_text: What documents are officially accepted as proof of father name in PAN card correction applications?
ground_truth_passage: Proof of Father Name: Matriculation certificate, Marksheet, Degree, Passport, Driving License.

query_text: What form and declaration must be submitted to seed Aadhaar into the PAN database?
ground_truth_passage: Form for Aadhaar seeding into PAN database: Consent for authentication and PAN-Aadhaar linking.

query_text: I got married and want to add my husband family name to my Aadhaar record. What papers do I bring?
ground_truth_passage: Change of surname of women, post marriage or divorce: Affidavit (Annexure D) & Marriage Certificate / Divorce Decree / POI.

query_text: My Aadhaar has my initials C. A. Tirkey and I want my full name Cornelius Ajas Tirkey written instead.
ground_truth_passage: Annexure A, Scenario (a): C A Tirkey to Cornelius Ajas Tirkey: Applicable POI in support of full name.

query_text: The computer operator typed Puja Singh as Pooja Singh during my Aadhaar visit. How can I rectify this typo?
ground_truth_passage: Annexure A, Scenario (f): Pooja Singh to Puja Singh: Applicable POI required for phonetic correction.

query_text: I want to adopt an entirely new personal identity and name in my official Aadhaar. Is an affidavit enough or is Gazette mandatory?
ground_truth_passage: Para 5: In case matching results in complete change in name / change of identity, liable to be rejected if not accompanied by a Gazette Notification.

query_text: What orthographic or phonetic alterations of a resident cognomen are admissible under standard POI verification?
ground_truth_passage: Minor correction in English spelling where names are phonetically similar: Applicable POI required.

query_text: What statutory evidentiary instrument enables expunging of aliases or urf designators from demographic registry?
ground_truth_passage: Name recorded with an urf or alias. Necessitates removal: For adults: Affidavit (Annexure E) & POI; For minors: Affidavit (Annexure F).

query_text: What is the period of temporal validity for a certificate issued by an authorized civic functionary or magistrate?
ground_truth_passage: Certificate for Aadhaar Enrolment/Update: Valid for 3 months from date of issue.

query_text: Aadhaar name change
ground_truth_passage: Standard Operation Procedure (SOP) for carrying out name update in Aadhaar.

query_text: Aadhaar Form 1
ground_truth_passage: FORM 1: Aadhaar Enrolment and Update For (a) Resident Indian, or (b) Non-Resident Indian having Proof of Address in India (aged 18 years and above).

query_text: Bal Aadhaar
ground_truth_passage: FORM 5: Aadhaar Enrolment and Update (below 5 years of age).

query_text: PAN correction form
ground_truth_passage: Request For Changes Or Correction in PAN Data [For an Individual].

query_text: Certifier certificate validity
ground_truth_passage: Certificate for Aadhaar Enrolment/Update: Valid for 3 months from date of issue.

query_text: I am an adult Indian female resident who recently got divorced, wants to revert to my maiden surname, and also need to correct an inadvertent middle-name spelling error. What form, affidavit, and proofs are required?
ground_truth_passage: Change of surname post marriage/divorce: Affidavit (Annexure D) on Rs. 10 stamp paper along with Divorce Decree/POI. Category 1 POI for middle name correction.

query_text: A child aged 14 whose parents are separated needs their name updated in Aadhaar using their mother passport as Head of Family proof. Which form is used and can the mother act as certifier?
ground_truth_passage: FORM 3: Aadhaar Enrolment and Update (aged 5 years and above and less than 18 years). Head of Family details and POR.

query_text: An adult citizen who lacks matriculation certificate, passport, or birth certificate needs to update their Date of Birth in both Aadhaar and PAN. What alternative certificates are admissible?
ground_truth_passage: Table 3: Proof of Date of Birth (DOB) - Birth certificate, PAN card, Marksheet, or Certificate issued by Gazetted Officer on Standard Format.

query_text: Which Aadhaar enrolment form must be used for a 7-year-old school student residing in India?
ground_truth_passage: FORM 3: For (a) Resident Indian child, or (b) Non-Resident Indian child having Proof of Address in India (aged 5 years and above and less than 18 years).

query_text: What are the biometric requirements for enrolling a 3-year-old child in Bal Aadhaar?
ground_truth_passage: For children below 5 years, only facial photograph is captured; fingerprints and iris scans are not captured.

query_text: At what specific milestones is mandatory biometric update required for enrolled children in Aadhaar?
ground_truth_passage: Biometric update is mandatory for children on attaining the age of 5 and 15 years.

query_text: Which form is dedicated to an adult resident aged 18 years and above for Aadhaar enrolment or updating mobile number?
ground_truth_passage: FORM 1: Aadhaar Enrolment and Update (aged 18 years and above).

query_text: Which form is prescribed for an adult Non-Resident Indian holding an overseas address for Aadhaar enrolment?
ground_truth_passage: FORM 1: For (a) Resident Indian, or (b) Non-Resident Indian having Proof of Address in India (aged 18 years and above).

query_text: Which form applies to a minor NRI child aged 5 to 18 years residing outside India for Aadhaar?
ground_truth_passage: FORM 4: For Non-Resident Indian child having Proof of Address outside India (aged 5 years and above and less than 18 years).

query_text: Which form must a resident foreign national aged 18 years and above submit for Aadhaar enrolment?
ground_truth_passage: FORM 7: For Resident Foreign National (aged 18 years and above).

query_text: Which form is prescribed for a foreign national child below 18 years residing in India for Aadhaar?
ground_truth_passage: FORM 8: For Resident Foreign National (aged below 18 years).

query_text: What is Form 95 under Income Tax Rules 158 used for?
ground_truth_passage: Form 95: Application for allotment of Permanent Account Number under Rule 158 of Income Tax Rules.

query_text: Does UIDAI waive charges for mandatory biometric update of children aged 7-15?
ground_truth_passage: Circular: Waiving off the charges for MBU-1 of children aged 7-15 years.

query_text: Is an Indian Passport recognized as both Proof of Identity (POI) and Proof of Address (POA) in Aadhaar?
ground_truth_passage: Table 1 Item 1: Passport (POI); Table 2 Item 1: Passport (POA).

query_text: How many months validity is permitted for electricity, water, and gas bills submitted as Proof of Address in Aadhaar?
ground_truth_passage: Table 2: Electricity Bill / Water Bill / Piped Natural Gas Bill (not older than 3 months).

query_text: Can a valid Ration Card be submitted as Proof of Relationship (POR) for Head of Family Aadhaar updates?
ground_truth_passage: Table 4: Proof of Relationship (POR). Item 1: PDS Card / Ration Card.

query_text: Can a Kisan Photo Passbook be used as Proof of Identity and Proof of Address in Aadhaar?
ground_truth_passage: Table 1 Item 8: Kisan Photo Passbook (POI); Table 2 Item 8: Kisan Passbook (POA).

query_text: What certificate format is prescribed for a destitute person with a disability who has no standard POI or POA?
ground_truth_passage: Certificate for Aadhaar Enrolment of Destitute Person with Disability, Above 18 Years of Age (Page 21).

query_text: Which authorized certifiers are permitted to issue the Standard Certificate for Aadhaar Enrolment/Update under Category 30/31?
ground_truth_passage: Certifiers: Gazetted Officer Group A/B, Village Panchayat Head/Mukhiya, MP, MLA, MLC, Tehsildar, Superintendent of Shelter Home.

query_text: What documents are officially accepted as Proof of Date of Birth for Aadhaar enrolment?
ground_truth_passage: Table 3: Birth Certificate issued by Registrar, Passport, PAN Card, Central/State Pension payment order.

query_text: What was the Aadhaar update exception workflow prescribed in the 2021 Exception Handling SOP?
ground_truth_passage: ABSTENTION: DOC_039 is HISTORICAL_REFERENCE (superseded by DOC_043 for name update); active RAG must not serve superseded circulars as active instructions.

query_text: How were name update exceptions handled under circular HQ-16022/2/2020-EU-I-HQ-Part(1) dated 28.10.2021?
ground_truth_passage: ABSTENTION: Circular dated 28.10.2021 is superseded by DOC_043 and quarantined from operational retrieval.

query_text: What are the citizen grievance escalation rules described in the 2021 Aadhaar Resident Handbook?
ground_truth_passage: ABSTENTION: DOC_038 Resident Handbook 2021 is HISTORICAL_REFERENCE; excluded from primary operational correction retrieval.

query_text: Does correcting a single minor typo in my Aadhaar name consume one of my two lifetime name update limits under the 2024 SOP?
ground_truth_passage: ABSTENTION: CLM_003 is CURRENT_APPLICABILITY_UNCONFIRMED; active circular DOC_043 does not specify lifetime quota impact for minor spelling fixes.

query_text: How can I escalate my third Aadhaar name update to the Regional Office for packet replay after exhausting two updates?
ground_truth_passage: ABSTENTION: CLM_008 and CLM_009 are CURRENT_APPLICABILITY_UNCONFIRMED; RO packet replay workflow from 2021 was omitted in DOC_043.

query_text: Can an operator error update request reset my lifetime name update counter back to zero in the UIDAI portal?
ground_truth_passage: ABSTENTION: CLM_002 is CURRENT_APPLICABILITY_UNCONFIRMED; DOC_043 requires sworn Affidavit Annexure B/C but omits quota-reset rules.

query_text: What is the procedure for updating gender a second time in Aadhaar using a surgeon certificate under current 2026 circulars?
ground_truth_passage: ABSTENTION: CLM_010 is CURRENT_APPLICABILITY_UNCONFIRMED; DOC_043 covers name updates only and no active circular re-confirms gender update limits.

query_text: Does UIDAI legally guarantee a lifetime limit of exactly two name updates under the Aadhaar Act?
ground_truth_passage: ABSTENTION: CLM_001 is CURRENT_APPLICABILITY_UNCONFIRMED; lifetime caps are administrative SOP rules, not statutory guarantees in the parent Act.

query_text: Can I submit an expired Passport as valid Proof of Identity for Aadhaar enrolment if it expired within 6 months?
ground_truth_passage: ABSTENTION: Prohibited by CLM_011; DOC_034 mandates all supporting documents must be valid and original on date of application.

query_text: Can I use a notarized affidavit instead of an official Gazette notification for a complete name change from Ram Kumar to Shyam Gupta?
ground_truth_passage: ABSTENTION / HARD_REJECTION: Prohibited by CLM_006; DOC_043 Para 5 strictly mandates Gazette Notification for Major Name Change.

query_text: What are the identity verification guidelines stated in the Azam Khan training presentation DOC_002?
ground_truth_passage: ABSTENTION: DOC_002 is AUTHENTICITY_UNCONFIRMED and strictly barred from authoritative RAG retrieval.

query_text: What are the Bureau of Civil Aviation Security photo identity requirements under DOC_014?
ground_truth_passage: ABSTENTION: DOC_014 is an aviation security circular, OUT_OF_SCOPE for citizen identity correction.

query_text: Can a college student union identity card be used as valid POI for Aadhaar enrolment?
ground_truth_passage: ABSTENTION: Student union cards are not recognized under DOC_034 Table 1.

query_text: Can I pay a fast-track tatkal processing fee of Rs. 1000 to bypass Gazette notification for name change in Aadhaar?
ground_truth_passage: ABSTENTION: No tatkal or fee-based Gazette bypass exists under UIDAI regulations.

query_text: How can I update my Aadhaar caste category from General to OBC using Form 1?
ground_truth_passage: ABSTENTION: Aadhaar does not record or update caste or religion under the Aadhaar Act.

query_text: My name is spelled differently in Aadhaar and PAN (e.g. Sanjay Kumar vs Sanjay K). How do I link them?
ground_truth_passage: Form for Aadhaar seeding into PAN database: Consent and identity matching declaration.

query_text: What is the required format of the Gazetted Officer certificate when used as Proof of Date of Birth for PAN correction?
ground_truth_passage: Documents acceptable as proof of date of birth in PAN: Certificate signed by a Gazetted Officer / Tehsildar in prescribed format.

query_text: Can a married woman update her father name instead of husband name in PAN card change request Form CSF?
ground_truth_passage: Instructions for Form CSF Item 1: Married women should only mention father name in the application; husband name is not permitted.

query_text: Does UIDAI permit dots or special characters in an applicant name in Aadhaar?
ground_truth_passage: DOC_043 Page 2: Name in Aadhaar shall be recorded in block letters... Dots and other special characters shall not be permitted in the name.

query_text: What happens if a resident requests removal of dots from their name in Aadhaar (e.g. R. P. Singh to R P Singh)?
ground_truth_passage: Annexure A, Scenario (m): Removal of dots from name (R.P. Singh to R P Singh): No document required.
